answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 39536 Country: India Title: When I made wudhu then I take water in the nose then I sneeze continuously and I lost my attention towards namaz Question: When I made wudhu then I take water in the nose then I sneeze continuously and I lost my attention towards namaz. So I want to know that due to the synose problem any way is there that I take wudhu without taking water on my mouth and nose because I am suffering from synos from last 10 years. My nose has been blocked by extra meat. Answer ID: 39536 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1145/832/D=1433) It is sunnah to rinse the nose and mouth during wudhu i.e. wudhu shall be valid instead of it but the excuse which you have mentioned is not such that by which you can always miss these sunnah, while in ghusl these two things are fardh and ghusl shall not be valid without them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
